prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily along a dimly lit road at night in East Maddon Park, London, under a heavy rain shower. The camera advances forward, capturing the wet asphalt reflecting faint light from distant street lamps, while the surrounding trees loom darkly on either side. As the movement continues, the road curves gently, revealing more of the park's layout, with the raindrops creating a consistent pattern against the camera lens. The environment remains empty, enhancing the sense of solitude. The camera then approaches a crosswalk marked by white stripes, flanked by lampposts that cast a soft glow, illuminating the immediate area with a pale yellow light. The path veers slightly to the right, leading into a more open section of the park where additional lampposts line the walkway, their light piercing through the misty air. The camera maintains a steady pace, capturing the rhythmic fall of rain and the subtle sway of tree branches in the wind. The scene transitions smoothly as the viewer moves deeper into the park, the camera angle occasionally shifting to highlight the interplay of light and shadow on the wet surfaces, all while maintaining a tranquil yet somber atmosphere characteristic of a rainy night in an urban park setting.
location: East Maddon Park, London, United Kingdom
